_comment: Feature catalog for the ImageCompare test dashboard. Each feature maps to the test(s) that cover it. `tests` references {suite: unit|webview|integration, match: <substring of the test title>}. An empty `tests` array means the feature is NOT yet covered (shown gray in the dashboard). The generator (generate.mjs) fills in pass/fail from real JSON reports.
